cloudOff.name: servers_enable
cloudOff.description: Turns one MCP server on again in one agent's own config on one computer or where a thread runs, by the switch that agent reads (Codex's enabled line, OpenCode's enabled field, Gemini CLI's mcp.excluded); Claude Code keeps no such switch per server and is refused. Written as the login the computer was added with, into that agent's own file, which keeps its mode; a file that is a link out of the home, or out of the project for a project's file, is not written through, and a file the agent wrote meanwhile is left as it was. A napping machine is not woken. The report there reads again at once.

name.description: the server's name, as servers lists it

agent.description: the catalog id of the agent whose config names it, as servers lists it

thread.description: a thread, by its id or a prefix of it, whose computer and project to read; absent reads a computer

on.description: the computer to read, by the name computers lists; absent with no thread is the computer the app runs on

scope.description: the scope servers lists it under: user, home, local or project; user without it

project.description: the project's server of that name: true with a thread, the thread's own project, or the project's name, as projects lists it, with on
